name: Sparse Point Set Haptic Rendering via Distance Field
aliases: Distance Field based Haptic Rendering of Scattered Oriented Points
definition: A haptic rendering technique for sparse point sets using an 'augmented point set' consisting of points P and outward facing unit normals n. It computes a 3D distance field by embedding minimum-sized spheres (packing spheres) into the object volume, then uses gradient descent to constrain a haptic proxy to the zero iso-surface of this field.
summary: Sparse Point Set Haptic Rendering via Distance Field generates stable collision forces for sparse point clouds by constructing a signed distance field from packing spheres, avoiding the failures of traditional mesh-based methods.
